subject: nt
track: Common curriculum; the M-Zug starts in Grade 7
hours: Two weekly hours across Grades 5–7 per BayMSO Anlage 1; no per-Lernbereich hours allocated in Fachlehrplan.

rows.competence: beobachten Alltagsphänomene mit naturwissenschaftlichem Hintergrund, formulieren dazu einfache Fragestellungen und führen mithilfe von konkreten Anleitungen einfache Untersuchungen unter Beachtung von Sicherheitsaspekten durch.
rows.evidence: Walks through observation, research question, hypothesis, guided investigation steps, and safety rules using an everyday example, plus an ordering workshop and writing prompts.
rows.additional: Hands-on physical observation and carrying out a real classroom investigation with physical lab materials take place in school.

rows.competence: verwenden nach Anleitung einfache Geräte und Materialien sachgerecht.
rows.evidence: Explains purpose and safe handling of beaker, test tube, funnel, magnifying glass, thermometer, and scale with drawn diagrams and classification workshop.
rows.additional: Handling and reading real physical instruments and glassware happen during classroom practicals.

rows.competence: verwenden Modelle zur Veranschaulichung naturwissenschaftlicher Sachverhalte, beschreiben deren Eigenschaften und vergleichen sie mit der Realität.
rows.evidence: Contrasts Earth, particle, and spine models with reality in drawn comparisons, quick checks, classification workshop, and two-level writing prompts.
rows.additional: Comparing commercial physical teaching models in the classroom enriches the discussion.

rows.competence: protokollieren angeleitet einfache Arbeitsabläufe und Ergebnisse.
rows.evidence: Shows standard experiment log sections (Frage, Vermutung, Aufbau, Beobachtung, Auswertung) and trains ordering and writing structured protocols.
rows.additional: Writing a live lab log during an actual classroom experiment accompanies school practical work.

rows.competence: stellen angeleitet einfache naturwissenschaftliche Sachverhalte dar.
rows.evidence: Models data tables, line charts, labelled sketch diagrams, quantities and units, with reading/interpreting workshops and writing tasks.
rows.additional: Drawing clean pencil measurement tables and graphs on paper complements the app.

rows.competence: erschließen sich aus ausgewählten Quellen Informationen zu vorgegebenen Fragestellungen.
rows.evidence: Provides structured factual short texts and verified reference links to practise extracting targeted answers for a given question.
rows.additional: Searching school library books or curated pupil encyclopedias extends source work in class.

rows.competence: unterscheiden bewusst zwischen alltagssprachlicher und fachsprachlicher Beschreibung von Phänomenen.
rows.evidence: Pairs everyday phrasing directly with exact scientific terminology in a classification workshop and guided writing exercises.
rows.additional: Practising precise spoken explanations during class presentations builds fluency further.

rows.competence: beurteilen verschiedene Maßnahmen und Verhaltensweisen zur Erhaltung der eigenen Gesundheit.
rows.evidence: Evaluates laboratory protective habits, daily sleep/hygiene/movement choices, and spine-friendly carrying and sitting across multiple lessons.
rows.additional: Applying these habits consistently in daily school and home life stays with the learner.

rows.competence: nutzen Fachwissen, um Sicherheitsmaßnahmen bei einfachen Experimenten zu erklären.
rows.evidence: Connects hazard pictograms and lab rules (tie back hair, wear safety goggles, never taste chemicals) directly to their scientific reasons.
rows.additional: Initial classroom safety briefing at the school lab benches remains mandatory before any real experiment.

rows.competence: beschreiben die Bewegungen der Erde, um die Entstehung von Tag und Nacht zu erkennen.
rows.evidence: Illustrates Earth's 24-hour rotation around its own axis relative to sunlight, including timezone and day/night classification and explanations.
rows.additional: Shining a torch onto a rotating globe in class makes the terminator line immediately tangible.

rows.competence: beschreiben die Bewegung der Erde um die Sonne sowie die Schrägstellung der Erdachse, um die Entstehung der Jahreszeiten zu begreifen.
rows.evidence: Interactive Earth orbit & tilted-axis lab (23,5°) with three goals plus worked summer/winter daylight explanations and writing prompts.
rows.additional: Tilting a real globe around a central lamp confirms why opposite hemispheres have opposite seasons.

rows.competence: beschreiben die Bedeutung der Sonne als Energiequelle, indem sie die Umwandlung von Strahlungsenergie in andere Energieformen erklären.
rows.evidence: Covers light focussing via magnifying lens/mirror, solar thermal collectors, photovoltaics, and solar energy transformations including Mont-Louis.
rows.additional: Observing a small solar cell powering a fan or measuring sunbeam warming outside adds real data.

rows.competence: begründen die Notwendigkeit einer einheitlichen Skala, um Temperaturen messen und vergleichen zu können.
rows.evidence: Contrasts subjective touch sensation with the fixed Celsius scale (0 °C melting ice, 100 °C boiling water) via scenario workshops and tasks.
rows.additional: Comparing lukewarm water after holding hands in cold vs. warm water makes the illusion memorable in class.

rows.competence: nutzen unterschiedliche Messgeräte zur Temperaturmessung und diskutieren deren unterschiedliche Verwendungszwecke.
rows.evidence: Explains liquid, bimetallic, and digital clinical/room/water thermometers, matches instruments to measurement tasks, and interprets reading logs.
rows.additional: Reading real liquid and bimetallic thermometers at water baths and outdoors happens in school.

rows.competence: leiten aus einfachen Versuchen den Zusammenhang zwischen Temperaturänderung und Volumenänderung ab und beschreiben diesen mithilfe eines Modells.
rows.evidence: Interactive thermometer & thermal expansion lab with particle speed/spacing model, three reachable goals, everyday gaps (bridges/rails), and tasks.
rows.additional: Heating a water-filled flask with a riser tube or a ball-and-ring apparatus provides the physical observation.

rows.competence: vergleichen experimentell die Wärmeleitfähigkeit verschiedener Stoffe, um deren Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Alltag zu erklären.
rows.evidence: Compares metals (copper, aluminium) with wood, cork, and trapped air in cookware and winter clothing, using particle/material classification tasks.
rows.additional: Testing wooden, plastic, and metal spoons placed in warm water shows conductivity differences by touch.

rows.competence: beschreiben an einem ausgewählten Beispiel das Prinzip des Wärmetransports und erklären Anwendungsbeispiele aus dem Alltag.
rows.evidence: Distinguishes Wärmeleitung, Wärmeströmung (convection), and Wärmestrahlung plus Temperaturausgleich on radiators, campfires, and thermos flasks.
rows.additional: Observing glitter or tea leaves circulating in warmed water demonstrates convection in class.

rows.competence: beschreiben mithilfe von Versuchen die Eigenschaften sowie mit Modellen den Aufbau der Haut und ordnen den einzelnen Hautbestandteilen deren Aufgaben zu.
rows.evidence: Cross-section SVG of Oberhaut, Lederhaut, and Unterhaut linking touch receptors, sweat glands, melanin pigments, hairs, and insulating fat.
rows.additional: Safe touch, two-point sensitivity, and hand-lens skin inspection take place directly in class.

rows.competence: erläutern die Schutzfunktion der Haut und beschreiben mögliche negative Folgen bei intensiver Sonneneinstrahlung, durch mechanische Beschädigungen oder chemische Einflüsse.
rows.evidence: Explains barrier protection and harms from intense UV light (Sonnenbrand, Sonnenstich, Hautkrebs), cuts/friction, and harsh cleaning agents.
rows.additional: Checking cleaning-product hazard labels at home (with adults) connects theory to household safety.

rows.competence: beschreiben Merkmale der gängigen Hauttypen und ziehen daraus Rückschlüsse auf angemessenes Verhalten an der Sonne.
rows.evidence: Describes fair-to-dark skin type traits (Hauttypen) and trains choosing shade, clothing (UPF 50+), time-of-day rules, and SPF sunscreen.
rows.additional: Checking the current local UV index forecast helps apply the rules on sunny days.

rows.competence: beschreiben die geradlinige Ausbreitung von Licht sowie die Entstehung von Schatten anhand von Experimenten.
rows.evidence: Traces straight light rays past opaque obstacles to distinguish Kern- and Halbschatten, with everyday shadow tasks and explanations.
rows.additional: Projecting shadows with torches, cardboard silhouettes, and translucent materials works well in darkened rooms.

rows.competence: erklären die Bedeutung der Reflexion im Straßenverkehr, um dortige Gefahrensituationen besser einschätzen zu können.
rows.evidence: Teaches the reflection law (Einfallswinkel = Ausfallswinkel), retroreflectors, bright clothing, and the truck blind spot (toter Winkel) in traffic.
rows.additional: Checking bicycle reflectors and stepping outside a real parked truck/bus blind spot with supervision reinforces safety.

rows.competence: beschreiben die Zerlegung von weißem Licht in seine Spektralfarben.
rows.evidence: Shows dispersion of white light through a glass prism into spectral colours and compares prisms to raindrops in rainbow formation.
rows.additional: Shining a narrow flashlight beam through a glass prism onto white paper lets pupils observe the spectrum firsthand.

rows.competence: beschreiben die Entstehung von Farbe durch Absorption von Farbanteilen des Lichts.
rows.evidence: Explains body colours via absorption of some spectral wavelengths and reflection of the remaining light (including dark vs. white surfaces in sun).
rows.additional: Illuminating coloured paper under red or blue light filters in a darkened room verifies absorption live.

rows.competence: beschreiben das Prinzip der Entstehung von Bildern im Auge unter Einbeziehung der optischen Abbildung durch Linsen.
rows.evidence: Explains eye parts and image projection through cornea and lens onto the retina (upside-down, smaller) in figure, workshop, and interactive eye lab.
rows.additional: Observing pupil constriction in changing light with a mirror complements the schematic optical model.

rows.competence: beschreiben, wie es zu Weit- und Kurzsichtigkeit kommen kann, und erklären, wie diese korrigiert werden können.
rows.evidence: Interactive eye-lens lab contrasting normal vision, myopia (eyeball too long / focal point in front of retina, Zerstreuungslinse), and hyperopia (Sammellinse).
rows.additional: Viewing distant and nearby text through real convex and concave optical lenses demonstrates correction directly.

rows.competence: verschaffen sich einen Überblick über wichtige Organsysteme des Menschen und deren Aufgaben.
rows.evidence: Interactive organ-systems torso lab with three goals covering Atmungssystem, Blutkreislaufsystem, Verdauungssystem, and Nervensystem plus cooperation.
rows.additional: Inspecting a dissectible school torso model lets learners examine spatial organ arrangement in 3D.

rows.competence: beschreiben Verhaltensweisen zur Erhaltung der eigenen Gesundheit und bewerten angeleitet deren Umsetzungsmöglichkeiten im Alltag.
rows.evidence: Covers sleep, balanced activity, hygiene, screen breaks, and evaluating realistic daily habit plans in Level 1 and Level 2 writing tasks.
rows.additional: Reflecting on one's own weekly routine and implementing chosen improvements takes place outside the app.

rows.competence: beschreiben den Weg der Nahrung im menschlichen Körper, benennen die an der Verdauung beteiligten Organe und ordnen ihnen ihre Funktionen zu.
rows.evidence: Follows food step-by-step through Mund, Speiseröhre, Magen, Dünndarm, Dickdarm, Enddarm and accessory glands with timeline workshop and diagrams.
rows.additional: Measuring chewing duration and starch breakdown of bread in class illustrates mechanical and mouth digestion.

rows.competence: erklären die Versorgung des Körpers mit Energie aus Nährstoffen.
rows.evidence: Explains carbohydrates, fats, proteins, water, minerals, vitamins, trace elements, and additives plus nutrient breakdown for energy and building blocks.
rows.additional: Testing foods on filter paper (fat stain) or reading ingredient tables brings nutrients into the classroom.

rows.competence: bewerten Ernährungsgewohnheiten unter dem Aspekt der Gesunderhaltung des eigenen Körpers.
rows.evidence: Trains evaluating meal plans and hidden sugar/fats in everyday snacks and drinks, linking poor habits to caries, obesity, and type-2 diabetes.
rows.additional: Comparing real nutrition labels of drinks and snacks brought by pupils anchors the habit check.

rows.competence: beschreiben mittels Abbildungen und Modellen den Aufbau des menschlichen Skeletts, um die Stütz- und Schutzfunktion des Skeletts zu erläutern.
rows.evidence: Covers skull, spine, ribcage, pelvis, and limb bones in SVG overview, support/protection classification, and worked tasks.
rows.additional: Feeling harmless landmarks (collarbone, kneecap, ribs) and studying a classroom skeleton add spatial orientation.

rows.competence: erklären anhand von Modellversuchen zur Form der Wirbelsäule, dass die Wirbelsäule Stöße abfedert und für den aufrechten Gang des Menschen verantwortlich ist.
rows.evidence: Contrasts straight rods with the double-S spine and cartilage discs (Bandscheiben) absorbing shock while protecting the spinal cord.
rows.additional: Building a simple wooden-spool and foam-disc spine model in class provides the physical shock-absorption test.

rows.competence: erklären den Bau und die Funktion unterschiedlicher Gelenke des menschlichen Körpers.
rows.evidence: Compares hinge (Scharnier-), ball-and-socket (Kugel-), and saddle (Sattel-) joints with anatomical sketches, workshops, and everyday examples.
rows.additional: Testing the actual range of motion of shoulder, elbow, and thumb joints confirms the joint types directly.

rows.competence: leiten durch Versuche am eigenen Körper und mittels Modellen ab, wie Bewegungen durch das Zusammenspiel von Gelenken, Muskeln und Sehnen ablaufen.
rows.evidence: Interactive arm-lever lab with 40°–170° elbow slider showing biceps/triceps antagonism and tendon pull on forearm bones.
rows.additional: Palpating one's own upper arm while bending and straightening confirms bicep tightening during flexion.

rows.competence: beschreiben Haltungsschäden und formulieren präventive Maßnahmen für einen gesunden Stütz- und Bewegungsapparat.
rows.evidence: Explains posture defects (Rundrücken, Hohlkreuz), backpack weight limits, ergonomic lifting from the knees, and joint-friendly sports.
rows.additional: Weighing school bags and practising squatting lifts and short desk stretch routines happen in school.

rows.competence: veranschaulichen den Unterschied zwischen Reinstoffen und Stoffgemischen mithilfe eines Teilchenmodells.
rows.evidence: Contrasts Reinstoffe with Gemenge, Suspension, Lösung, and Emulsion in the particle model alongside sorting workshops and examples.
rows.additional: Stirring sand, salt, and oil into water in class shows heterogeneous mixtures vs. clear solutions live.

rows.competence: beschreiben mithilfe eines Teilchenmodells die charakteristischen Aggregatzustände ausgewählter Stoffe bei Zimmertemperatur.
rows.evidence: Interactive particle lab switching solid/liquid/gas states and substances at room temperature with particle order, spacing, and motion goals.
rows.additional: Comparing ice, water, steam, wood, and air in syringes illustrates compressibility vs. fixed shape.

rows.competence: untersuchen Stoffe hinsichtlich typischer Eigenschaften, um Steckbriefe von einzelnen Stoffen zu erstellen.
rows.evidence: Teaches characteristic tests (appearance, solubility, magnetism, flammability, electrical conductivity) and builds Sugar, Paper, and Iron profiles.
rows.additional: Safely testing sample substances with a magnet, water glass, simple bulb circuit, and teacher-supervised flame happens in the lab.

rows.competence: trennen ausgewählte Stoffgemische experimentell und vergleichen ihre Ergebnisse mit einfachen Trennverfahren aus Alltag und Technik.
rows.evidence: Links separation techniques (Sieben, Sedimentieren/Dekantieren, Filtrieren, Verdampfen) via physical properties to coffee filters and salt works.
rows.additional: Performing hands-on filtration and gentle evaporation of saltwater takes place in the school lab.

rows.competence: beschreiben Müll als Stoffgemisch und erklären, wie man mit Trennverfahren Wertstoffe isolieren kann, um sie anschließend wiederzuverwerten.
rows.evidence: Treats household waste as a complex Stoffgemisch and explains manual sorting, magnetic separation (iron), air classification (Windsichten), and recycling loops.
rows.additional: Sorting classroom waste bins and visiting a local recycling depot (Wertstoffhof) connect lessons to local practice.
